title: Daily set · Nov 28
title_zh: 每日新题 · 11 月 28 日
summary: Five new agent questions: dependent tool calls made in parallel with an invented ID, ad spend in micros and mixed currencies, duplicate webhooks that start two agent runs, a revoked user still seeing documents through retrieval, and merchant rules that never reached the worker agents.
summary_zh: 五道新的 Agent 题：带着编造 ID 并行发出的相互依赖的工具调用、以 micros 计的广告花费和混合币种、启动了两次 Agent 运行的重复 webhook、被撤销权限的用户仍能通过检索看到文档，以及没能传达到 worker Agent 的商家规则。

questions.title: The ad-launch agent calls create_campaign and create_ad_set in the same turn, and the ad set points at a campaign ID the model made up
questions.title_zh: 广告投放 Agent 在同一轮里同时调用 create_campaign 和 create_ad_set，而广告组指向的是一个模型编造出来的广告系列 ID
questions.question:
The ad-launch agent sets up Meta campaigns for merchants. Logs show that in one turn it often asks for `create_campaign` and `create_ad_set` together. The harness runs a turn's tool calls concurrently, so the ad set call carries a campaign ID such as `cmp_new` that the model invented, and the platform rejects it. Sometimes the model then reports both steps as done.

Explain why this happens and how to fix it without giving up parallel calls everywhere.
questions.question_zh:
广告投放 Agent 负责为商家搭建 Meta 广告系列。日志显示，它经常在同一轮里同时请求 `create_campaign` 和 `create_ad_set`。框架会并发执行同一轮里的工具调用，于是创建广告组的调用带着一个模型编造出来的广告系列 ID，比如 `cmp_new`，平台随即拒绝了它。有时模型还会接着报告两步都已完成。

解释为什么会这样，以及如何在不全面放弃并行调用的前提下修复它。
followups: Two independent reads and one write that depends on both are requested in the same turn. What should the harness do?
How would you write an eval case that catches invented IDs?
When would you prefer one composite tool over several small ones?
followups_zh: 同一轮里请求了两个独立的读操作，以及一个依赖这两者的写操作。框架应该怎么做？
你会如何写一个能抓住编造 ID 的评测用例？
什么时候你会更倾向于用一个组合工具，而不是几个小工具？

questions.title: The ad-report tool passes Google's cost_micros and Meta's spend strings straight through, and the agent tells a merchant they spent $4.5 billion
questions.title_zh: 广告报表工具把 Google 的 cost_micros 和 Meta 的花费字符串原样透传，结果 Agent 告诉商家他们花了 45 亿美元
questions.question:
The reporting agent answers "how much did I spend on ads last week?" with a `get_ad_spend` tool that returns the platforms' raw responses. Google Ads reports cost in micros, Meta returns spend as a decimal string in the ad account's currency, and one merchant runs a Japanese account in yen. The agent told a merchant they spent $4.5 billion on Google, added yen to dollars in a total, and once compared Google's numbers for a day in the account's time zone with Meta's numbers for a different day.

Redesign the tool output so the model cannot make these mistakes.
questions.question_zh:
报表 Agent 用一个 `get_ad_spend` 工具回答「我上周在广告上花了多少钱？」，这个工具直接返回各平台的原始响应。Google Ads 以 micros 为单位报告花费，Meta 以广告账户币种的十进制字符串返回花费，还有一位商家经营着一个以日元结算的日本账户。Agent 告诉一位商家他们在 Google 上花了 45 亿美元，在合计里把日元和美元直接相加，还有一次拿 Google 某一天（按账户时区）的数据，去和 Meta 另一天的数据做比较。

重新设计工具的输出，让模型无法再犯这些错误。
followups: A merchant asks for total spend across a USD and a JPY account. How should the agent answer?
How would you test the converters so a platform API change is caught before the agent sees it?
followups_zh: 商家问一个美元账户和一个日元账户的总花费。Agent 应当如何回答？
你会如何测试这些转换器，让平台 API 的变化在 Agent 看到之前就被发现？

questions.title: A carrier's delay webhook arrives twice, two agent runs start, and the shopper gets two apology emails with two different discount codes
questions.title_zh: 承运商的延迟 webhook 到了两次，于是启动了两次 Agent 运行，顾客收到了两封道歉邮件，附带两个不同的折扣码
questions.question:
When a carrier reports a delayed parcel, a webhook starts an agent run that checks the order, writes an apology and creates a 10% discount code. Carriers deliver webhooks at least once, and some send a second notice for the same delay later. Several shoppers received two apologies with two different codes, and finance found discount codes created for the same order twice.

Make this flow run exactly once per real delay.
questions.question_zh:
当承运商报告包裹延误时，一个 webhook 会启动一次 Agent 运行：检查订单、撰写道歉信，并创建一个 9 折折扣码。承运商投递 webhook 遵循「至少一次」，有些还会在之后针对同一次延误再发一条通知。好几位顾客收到了两封道歉信、两个不同的折扣码，财务也发现同一个订单被创建了两次折扣码。

让这个流程针对每一次真实的延误只执行一次。
followups: The agent run crashes after creating the code but before sending the email. What happens on the next delivery?
How would you test this flow for duplicate and out-of-order webhooks?
followups_zh: Agent 运行在创建折扣码之后、发送邮件之前崩溃了。下一次投递时会发生什么？
你会如何针对重复和乱序的 webhook 测试这个流程？

questions.title: A staff member lost access to wholesale price lists yesterday, and the internal assistant still answers with wholesale prices
questions.title_zh: 一名员工昨天失去了批发价目表的访问权限，内部助手却仍然用批发价回答他
questions.question:
Large merchants use an internal assistant that answers staff questions from the store's documents: policies, supplier contracts and price lists. Documents have permissions, and the retrieval index stores each chunk's allowed readers so searches can filter by user. A merchant removed one staff member's access to wholesale price lists after a contract dispute. The next morning, that person asked about a coat and the assistant quoted the wholesale price.

Explain the failure and design permission handling for retrieval.
questions.question_zh:
大商家会使用一个内部助手，根据店铺的文档回答员工的问题：各类政策、供应商合同和价目表。文档带有权限，检索索引为每个分块存了允许读取的人员名单，这样搜索时就能按用户过滤。一位商家在一次合同纠纷之后，撤销了一名员工对批发价目表的访问权限。第二天早上，这个人问起一件大衣，助手报出了批发价。

解释这个故障，并为检索设计权限处理。
followups: A document's permissions are "anyone in Finance". How do you check that quickly at query time?
How would you test that no answer ever contains text the asking user cannot read?
Should the assistant tell a user that some documents were hidden from them?
followups_zh: 一份文档的权限是「财务部的所有人」。你如何在查询时快速检查这一点？
你会如何测试，确保任何回答都不会包含提问者无权读取的文本？
助手是否应该告诉用户，有些文档对他不可见？

questions.title: The merchant told the lead agent "never touch the Black Friday campaigns", and three of the workers it started paused them anyway
questions.title_zh: 商家对主 Agent 说「绝不要动黑五的广告系列」，可它启动的 worker 里有三个还是把这些广告系列暂停了
questions.question:
A campaign-optimization system has a lead agent that talks to the merchant and delegates per-account work to worker agents, each with tools to pause campaigns and change budgets. Early in the chat, the merchant said "never touch the Black Friday campaigns". The lead acknowledged it. An hour later, three workers paused Black Friday campaigns that looked unprofitable. The briefs the lead sent them did not mention the rule.

Design the system so the merchant's constraints hold for every agent.
questions.question_zh:
一个广告系列优化系统里，主 Agent 负责和商家对话，并把每个账户的工作委派给 worker Agent，每个 worker 都有暂停广告系列和修改预算的工具。对话一开始，商家就说了「绝不要动黑五的广告系列」，主 Agent 也确认了。一个小时后，有三个 worker 暂停了几个看起来不赚钱的黑五广告系列。主 Agent 发给它们的任务说明里，没有提到这条规则。

设计这个系统，让商家的约束对每一个 Agent 都生效。
followups: The merchant later says "actually, you can lower the Black Friday budgets, just don't pause them". How does the system change?
A worker is a third-party agent you do not control. Where does enforcement live now?
How would you show the merchant which rules are active in a long session?
followups_zh: 商家后来又说「其实可以降低黑五的预算，只是别暂停」。系统要怎么改？
如果某个 worker 是你无法控制的第三方 Agent，强制执行该放在哪里？
在一个很长的会话里，你会如何向商家展示哪些规则正在生效？
